items.name: TerrainMaster 5§ Portable Cabin
items.description: The TerrainMaster stows in a convenient backpack frame. While it is a serious load for one hiker, the stowage frame includes a built-in mass neutralizer that reduces its mass to 5 kilograms when activated. The neutralizer has an endurance of 20 hours at this setting or 50 hours if set to reduce to 15 kg.

items.name: Gliese 300 habitat dome
items.description: The Gliese 300 habitat dome is made of microengineered numaplas—a tough, heavy plastic fabric chambered with self-inflating pneumatic bladders. A single standard COg cartridge (two are included) can deploy the dome in moments. When inflated, the dome is 2 meters tall and 5 meters in diameter.

items.name: ARMADILLO MPT Two-MAN TENT
items.description: The ARMADILLO MPT Two-MAN TENT is a lightweight, easy to use tent that offers comfort and durability. It provides support for two people with a single numaplas support matrix, which inflates with a handy foot-pedal providing it with a structure lighter and stronger than aluminum. The tent weighs 1 kg and costs $135. It's available in any location.

items.name: Unner 60 CLIMATE SuIT
items.description: The Unner 60 Climate Suit is a versatile, lightweight and comfortable suit designed to keep you safe and cool in non-vacuum extraterrestrial environments. Its heating/cooling elements allow for long-endurance work and travel in environments with toxic, thin, dense, or mildly corrosive atmospheres.

items.name: Explorer D9 Armored E-Suit
items.description: The Explorer's armored E-Suit is lined with a self-sealing, puncture-resistant inner layer. It provides protection against environmental hazards like vacuum, gravity, radiation, and atmospheric pressure changes. The suit loses its integrity if the wearer suffers 4 points or more of primary wound or mortal damage.
